current_evidence: The council's 'Submitting a planning application' page (last updated 27 May 2026) still links 'Local Validation List (February 2024)', mentions no newer list or consultation, and a web search found no replacement.

issues.detail: Householder lists only the CIL form and photographs. Section 2.1 also lists the biodiversity checklist, design and access statement, heritage statement, tree information, flood risk assessment, site sections/levels, roof plans (more than single storey) and lighting assessment (outbuildings, pools, stables, ménages). The block plan must also show a wall, gate or fence.

Outline, Advertisement consent, Variation of condition s73 and Non-material amendment are marked '(none)', but the list has local requirements for each. Outline needs indicative access details and a biodiversity checklist. Adverts need advert sections and lighting details if illuminated. S73 and s96A need an amendment statement, and removal or variation of a condition needs a planning statement. Grokbot instead put 'Planning Statement' (whose excerpt is the vary/remove-condition text) under Full planning.
issues.evidence: 2.9 Advertisement consent; 2.10 Outline; 2.11 Conditions; 2.12 Amendments; Grokbot excerpt 'details of why you wish to vary or remove the condition'

issues.detail: Under Listed building consent, Grokbot puts only 'Lighting Assessment / External lighting scheme'. Lighting details are for illuminated shop fronts and adverts. LBC's local requirements are a design and access statement and heritage statement (core), plus floor plans, elevations, block plan and roof plans where relevant.
issues.evidence: 2.4 Listed building consent: core LBC form, site location plan, DAS, heritage statement

issues.detail: Almost all rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', which hides the size thresholds in the list. Section 2 splits non-residential (<1,000 / >1,000 sqm), residential (replacement, <10, 10-49, 50+), change of use, rural conversions and shop fronts. Health Impact Assessment and Transport Assessment are core only for 50+ units. Air Quality is core for 50+ units. Affordable Housing applies at 11+ units. Fire Statement applies only to 18m+ or 7+ storey buildings.
issues.evidence: 2.3 Residential 50+ units core list; Affordable housing statement '11 or more residential units'

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are wrong text or fragments. Fire Statement is a run of table headings, while the source trigger is residential buildings 18m+ or 7+ storeys. Heritage Statement is 'Document type Heritage statement When is it required? Tree information' (no trigger). Environmental Statement uses an air-quality sentence. Ventilation/Extraction uses the noise sentence, while the source trigger is hot food on premises or a commercial flue. Design and Access Statement is just 'to contents Design and access statement'. Flood Risk Assessment omits the trigger (FZ2/3 or over 1 ha in FZ1).
issues.evidence: Fire statement: residential buildings 18m+ above ground level or 7+ storeys; FRA: any part in Flood Zone 2/3 or >1ha in Zone 1

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' has a viability text excerpt ('professionals and a method statement of how costs have been calculated'). The list has no listed-building schedule of works. 'Housing mix / dwelling standards (NDSS)' is matched to M4(3) affordable dwellings under Policy DM1. The actual local requirement is an Accommodation Schedule for 10+ units.
issues.evidence: Accommodation Schedule: 10 or more residential units

issues.detail: Local requirements missing from Grokbot: Sustainable Development Checklist (residential and non-residential), Biodiversity checklist and report (householder/minor, non-householder and major versions), Tree information (TPO trees or trees in a Conservation Area), Site sections/levels (significant level changes), Accommodation Schedule (10+ units), Agricultural appraisal (agricultural workers' dwellings or removal of occupancy condition), Agricultural Land Classification survey (major development on agricultural land), Land contamination assessment, Lighting assessment (new external lighting), Retail and leisure impact assessment (>2,500 sqm), ICNIRP certificate (telecoms), SuDS information (10+ dwellings / >0.5-1 ha), Parameter plans (allocated Strategic Growth Sites), Amendment statement, Statement of existing agricultural activity, and Manufacturer's specification (plant/machinery).
issues.evidence: Section 2 tables and section 3.2 guidance headings

issues.detail: 'Block plan / Site plan' and 'Floor plans / Elevations' under Full planning share the same excerpt (the walls, gates and fences householder table). That excerpt is about householder boundary treatments, not full applications.
issues.evidence: '** Block Plan must include the location of the wall/gate/fence.'

issues.detail: The tab_items are process text and fragments, not requirements: an administrative charge on invalid applications, two hard copies, 'Back to contents' headings and ICNIRP 'More information' text.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'In disposing of the application, an administrative charge will be deducted...'

issues.detail: List date 2024-02-01 is inferred from the URL. The document cover says only 'February 2024', which is correct. The list is now over 2 years old with no announced review.

summary: Grokbot's link is still the current Chelmsford list (February 2024). The extraction misses most local requirements, notably the biodiversity checklist, Sustainable Development Checklist, tree information, accommodation schedule, ALC survey and contamination. It also marks Outline, Advert, S73 and NMA as having no local requirements, puts lighting under LBC, and lumps everything else under Full planning with garbled triggers.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
